posts.cooked:
Hi.

I bought the sentinel comics starter kit last spring without knowing about the Kickstarter project. I'm very hype about this game. 

Since I missed my chance with the Kickstarter, I'm wondering when the book, GM screen, etc, will be release and, if it's in a long time, if there is a way to have acces to the core book's rules, especially for the character creation system.

I try to find infos on the internet but I didn't find any about the rules book nor the character creation, except for the character sheet.

If someone can help me, it will be appreciate.

Thanks.

posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked: Except to those who backed directly through KS there are no chapters or anything available to anyone yet until GtG releases the full core Rulebook.  If you'd like to preorder you can do so here https://sentinel-comics-rpg.backerkit.com/hosted_preorders but it will not grant you access to the preview chapters through the KS.
